en.answer:
Even in that case, the part of the effect of <<5576>> that sends all cards in your hand to the Graveyard is applied normally.

In that case, all cards in your hand are banished.
en.question: During the End Phase of the turn in which <<5576>> was activated, if the effect of <<6682>> is being applied, how does the part of the effect of <<5576>> resolve?
en.title: During the End Phase of the turn in which <<5576>> was activated, if the effect of <<6682>> is being applied, how does the part of the effect of <<5576>> resolve?

ja.answer:
「<<5576>>」を発動したターンのエンドフェイズに「<<6682>>」が適用されている場合でも、「<<5576>>」の『このターンのエンドフェイズに、自分の手札を全て墓地へ送る』処理は適用されます。

その場合、自分の手札は全て除外される事になります。
